data.name: Giacobo
data.gender_notes: Giacobo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Giacobo, derived from the Hebrew 'Ya'aqob' meaning 'supplanter' or 'deceiver' because Jacob 'deceived' his father Isaac by taking the blessing meant for his older brother Esau. Later in life, Jacob was himself deceived by his sons Joseph's coat, but God's plan was ultimately fulfilled through Jacob. The name Giacobo carries the meaning “God's Supplanter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Giacobo usually hope their child will grow to embody god's supplanter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of God's plan and deception leading to redemption and blessings.
data.etymology: Giacobo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Supplanter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Giacobo total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_greek.name: Ἰακώβ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰακώβ (Mt 1:2, Mk 9:35, Lk 3:34). ἐπώνυμος, πρωτότοκος, πολύτιμος, πατήρ (Gen 25:26, Gen 27:36, Gen 32:28, Gen 35:10). Ὀνόματα προέλευσης ἀπὸ Ἑβραϊκοῦ, ὀνομασία τοῦ πρωτοτόκου ἀπὸ τοῦ ἰακοβ τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ. Ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἰακωβ τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ ἡ πίστις ὑπάρχει (Gen 15:6).

in_latin.name: Iacobus
in_latin.long_meaning: Iacobus (Mt 1:2, Mk 9:35, Lk 3:34). Pater, primogenitus, pretiosus (Gen 25:26, Gen 27:36, Gen 32:28, Gen 35:10). Nomen originis Hebraicae, nomen primogeniti a Iacobo, fratre Abrahae. Fides a Iacobo, fratre Abrahae, inest (Gen 15:6).
